card.name: Start of drug names after 'of'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand or drug name (such as U, CAB, CARD) right after words like 'administration of' or 'dose of' in interaction and dosing text. Also fires on a space before a number in dose lists.

modes.label: Drug name start
modes.description: The opening piece of a drug name split into parts, after 'of' or 'such as'.

modes.label: Before dose number
modes.description: An empty-looking space or digit just before a dose or reference number.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug name or dose number is about to begin, in interaction and dosing sections.
